user.title: Connect EcoVolter
user.description: Enter the charger's serial number, IP address or hostname and Local API secret.

data.host: Serial number, IP address or hostname

tariff_type.title: Which tariff do you have?
tariff_type.description: The scheduler uses it to find the cheapest time.

menu_options.spot: Spot – price changes every hour / 15 min

spot.title: Spot price
spot.description: Do you have a sensor with the **final price** – incl. distribution and VAT?

menu_options.spot_final_yes: Yes – I have the final price

spot_final_yes.title: Final price sensor
spot_final_yes.description: Choose the sensor whose price already includes distribution and VAT. If it also states the tariff (VT/NT), the next step is skipped.

spot_final_no.title: Spot price and fees
spot_final_no.description: Enter all prices **excl. VAT**. Final price = (spot + markup + distribution) × VAT – shown in the summary.

data.price_entity: Spot price sensor (e.g. Czech Energy Spot Prices)

fixed2.title: Fixed two-rate tariff
fixed2.description: Prices per kWh **excl. VAT**; final prices are shown in the summary.

fixed1.title: Fixed single rate
fixed1.description: Prices per kWh **excl. VAT**; the final price is shown in the summary.

tariff_source.title: Where do low and high tariff come from?
tariff_source.description: NT/VT times are needed for prices and the Low tariff only mode.

tariff_cez.title: ČEZ Distribuce
tariff_cez.description: Choose the **raw data** sensor of the ČEZ HDO integration (e.g. `sensor.cez_hdo_raw_data_…`). The NT schedule is read 7 days ahead.

tariff_sensor.title: HDO sensor
tariff_sensor.description: A "low tariff active" binary sensor (on = NT) or a sensor with a start/end window list. A binary sensor only knows the current state – add VT times for planning ahead.

tariff_manual.title: High tariff times
tariff_manual.description: When the **high tariff (VT)** applies, comma separated. All other time is NT.

cars.title: Cars
cars.description: How many cars do you charge with this charger? Cars enable % targets and detecting which car is plugged in.

car.title: Car {number} of {count}
car.description: The **battery sensor** (from the car's integration) enables % targets. The **plug sensor** (e.g. "charging cable connected" or "charging") tells which car is plugged in. Both optional.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the API secret.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while communicating with EcoVolter.
error.invalid_price_sensor: The sensor has no prices in a supported format.
error.invalid_cez: No ČEZ schedule (datum + casy) found. Choose the raw data sensor.
error.invalid_hdo: The sensor is neither binary nor has start/end windows.
error.invalid_car_name: Choose another name (each car needs a unique name).
error.battery_required: Enter the battery capacity for the battery sensor.

init.title: EcoVolter settings
init.description: What do you want to change?

interval.title: Refresh interval
interval.description: How often to read the charger. 2 s recommended.
